records.affected_users_text: Atomic Wallet stated that fewer than 0.1% of monthly active app users were affected.
records.description: Atomic Wallet reported receiving user complaints on June 3, 2023 about unauthorized transactions from affected wallets and said funds associated with the incident were being mixed and laundered while the company investigated.
records.notes: Atomic Wallet examined several possible causes, including local malware, infrastructure compromise, malware code injection and man-in-the-middle attack, but stated that none had been confirmed. WLR therefore does not assign an affected version range, product runtime, root cause or total loss amount.
records.title: Atomic Wallet users reported unauthorized transactions

records.notes: Atomic Wallet's first-party history records a desktop release in Q1 2018.
records.title: About us | Atomic Wallet

records.notes: Current first-party site identifies Atomic Wallet as a non-custodial decentralized wallet and currently distributes desktop builds.

records.notes: Atomic Wallet states that on June 3 it received reports of unauthorized transactions, that fewer than 0.1% of monthly active app users were affected, and that several possible causes were investigated without a confirmed root cause.
